status: metric correction frozen before v2 development and held-out rerun
metric_revision: V1 incorrectly credited partial on-time service of incomplete original items. V2 primary efficiency credits total bytes only when the entire original job/burst completes by its original deadline, for every class. Partial service remains a separate utilization diagnostic. No policy, workload, seed, admission, or scheduler change; preserved v1 is superseded for primary efficiency. V2 also rejects edits to unsupported hardcoded protocol semantics.
claim_scope: Deterministic preemptive byte-service model; not host, packet-radio, or 6G validation.
floor_rule: ceil(nominal_units / delivered_service_factor), with video nominal units ceil(40*load); every service quota uses floor(650*factor*units/106)

tenant.payload_basis: fraction of nominal, not factor-adjusted, service; release certificate decides feasibility

infeasible_cells: Record provisioning rejection for protected policies; do not execute an impossible incumbent contract. Run the no-video-contract diagnostic with its explicitly weaker contract.
accounting: Keep all offered jobs, including rejected tenant requests and expired bytes; primary credit for EVERY class requires full item completion by original deadline. Partial service is charged as consumed capacity but never credited as complete timely payload.
expiry: All policies discard unsent bytes at the original deadline and count failure; no deadline resets.

statistics.unit: independently generated workload seed, paired across policies within a cell

non_disruption_definition: Preserve admitted critical/video/monitor deadlines and reserved service. Opportunistic throughput and identical latency are not promised.
changes_after_evaluation: Any change to workload, model, protocol, or seeds requires a new version and new output directory.
